fixed_window.objective: Two different stable competition-pool share candidates, individually 5% and 10%; joint interaction recomputed; actual formal payability remains separate.
fixed_window.authorization: User: 继续吧,再研究4h 按上次的方案. This is an additional fixed window, not a rewrite of the interrupted original eight-hour window.
fixed_window.scope: Research implementation, experiment-branch commits/pushes, manual public GitHub runner experiments, original public gates and frozen independent confirmation. No formal upload, registration, signing, spending, merge or branch deletion.
fixed_window.running_job_policy: Jobs finish naturally or at declared timeout. Runtime and collection allowance must fit this deadline. No budget restart after compaction.
fixed_window.delegation: Two route owners; third child only for a specific scoring, measurement or proof bottleneck. Root alone handles Git and CI.
fixed_window.host_goal_status_note: Existing goal remains blocked with the old objective. create_goal rejected replacement because that goal is unfinished; no resume tool is available. New human authorization is recorded here; do not mark old target complete to change metadata.

snapshot.freshness_reason: Recorded scoring pass; live policy changes require a new pass.

limits: This is a snapshot-specific evidence summary, not a declaration that the fixed window has ended.
Each measured main candidate has discovery observations only. Copies and calibration views are not extra independent confirmations.
Unmeasured share is UNKNOWN. Public projection is conditional on calibration, admission and eligible independent identities, not formal reward.
